integrity: Theorem includes its proof and finite independent-implementation checker. Finite enumeration corroborates but is not a universal proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields, nonzero prescribed evaluation values and monic degree at least two only. Counts discriminant squareclasses, not individual discriminants or irreducible-only populations. Formula uses classical Euler products and Jacobi sums. Literature comparison is nonexhaustive; broader classical Dirichlet-L-function coverage remains possible.
title: Jacobi-sum spectrum and a field-size dichotomy for two-point discriminant biases
